effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Egregore (incl. 'The Egregore Technology Map', 'the egregore you described', 'the actual egregore property')
effect_translations.observable_effect: A standing institutional process whose authorized goals, law, history and capabilities persist across sessions, vendors, models and the founder's attention; it converts evidence into gated external consequences, retains verified outcomes as assets, and reduces founder interventions per verified outcome. Explicitly not consciousness and not a collective mind.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Versioned constitution files + append-only ledger + capability registry as plain, signed, exportable files; a scheduler that resumes durable goals; one commit-time gate; a monthly interventions-per-outcome report.
effect_translations.falsification: A clean machine cannot reconstruct the institution's law, history and capabilities from exported files; or no authorized goal survives a session restart; or interventions per verified outcome do not fall over two quarters.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Morphogenesis ('Morphogenesis compiles a swarm the way it compiles an organ')
effect_translations.observable_effect: Functional capability formation or reconfiguration in response to a verified discrepancy or CapabilityDeficit: a missing capability is acquired, composed, adapted or built, attached under a bounded grant, and the original goal resumes.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: A CapabilityDeficit record -> resourcefulness-ladder search (existing capability, composition, commodity, open source, API, computer use, small adapter, coding agent) -> sandbox test -> registry entry with authority envelope -> goal resume. Ordinary orchestration code; no cells, tissues, developmental fields or self-assembling organizations.
effect_translations.falsification: A recorded deficit is closed only by a new framework when a cheaper existing mechanism satisfied the acceptance tests; or capability formation occurs without a verified deficit; or the newly attached capability acts without a fresh grant.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Organism / organs / organelles / 'the finished organism' / 'Final as genome. Never final as organism.'
effect_translations.observable_effect: Bounded specialist subsystems with explicit contracts, authority ceilings, state ownership, lifecycle and shutdown behavior, connected through typed events; the whole continues when any non-core subsystem is detached; the specification is versioned while the system changes only through evidence-gated releases.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Organ manifests + module loader (inspect/attach/pause/detach/rollback) + typed contracts; versioned docs and signed releases for the 'genome'.
effect_translations.falsification: Detaching a non-core module breaks the gate or ledger; or a subsystem lacks a declared authority ceiling and shutdown behavior; or 'organism completeness' is claimed without a detach test and a governed external action.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Immune system ('Give UNIIMENTE an immune system'; 'the immune system converts every failure into a rule, a test and a policy diff')
effect_translations.observable_effect: Attacks and failures are detected, contained, recovered from and learned from: each incident yields preserved evidence, root cause, a detection rule, a regression test, a policy diff and a recovery procedure; repeat incidents are caught.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Incident records on the ledger + CI regression tests + monitoring rules + runbooks + revocation/quarantine of grants; amendments proposed through the human-ratified ceremony.
effect_translations.falsification: A recorded incident has no linked test or detection rule; a replayed attack passes undetected; or an 'immune' component alters policy without ratification.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Metabolism / 'evidence-to-settlement metabolism' / 'regenerative capital metabolism' / 'the treasury makes the organism self-feeding'
effect_translations.observable_effect: Evidence flows to accepted outcome credentials to payment, permission or contract-state change; surplus flows through a fixed allocation order that funds obligations, reliability and reserves before expansion; measured negative externalities block growth until repaid.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Reconciliation engine + settlement adapter (invoice/AP/AR) + a rule-ordered allocation ledger with regenerative-debt flags that the autonomy and budget engines read as hard blockers.
effect_translations.falsification: Revenue is booked without a reconciled receipt; an allocation skips a waterfall position; or no regenerative-debt finding blocks any promotion, budget or replication in a year.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Regeneration / healing / 'restore the function'
effect_translations.observable_effect: A lost or degraded function returns under preserved authority and obligations, possibly with a different implementation; interrupted work is reconciled and resumed.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Degradation detection -> localize lost capability -> candidate replacement (existing/open-source/rebuilt) -> verification -> re-attach under the same grant envelope -> resume interrupted workflow from durable state.
effect_translations.falsification: The replacement acts with more authority than the original; or restoration is claimed while interrupted obligations remain unreconciled.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Immortality / continuity / 'survive any vendor, model, or employee' / 'Continuity Seed' / succession
effect_translations.observable_effect: Founder intent and institutional capability survive component failure: replaceable models, reproducible infrastructure, durable state, provenance, backups, succession and vendor independence; shutdown-safe restoration.
effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Exportable signed files, rebuild-from-ledger drills, infrastructure-as-code, key custody and succession documents with a tested recovery drill. 'Continuity Seed' must be specified before it is treated as a mechanism.
effect_translations.falsification: A rebuild drill fails; a provider swap loses decisions; or no documented, tested succession path exists for the founder's keys and authority.

effect_translations.metaphor_or_phrase: Nervous system / 'institutional nervous system' / Distributed Event Spine

effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: Typed event contracts over an organ-neutral transport (in-memory, SQLite, Postgres outbox/inbox; optional broker later) with idempotency keys and signatures.
effect_translations.falsification: An organ acts on an unsigned or stale message; duplicate delivery produces a duplicate external effect; or a cross-organ edge exists outside typed contracts.

effect_translations.simplest_mechanism: A typed instruction schema + canonical serialization + hash + policy evaluation + signed approval over the hash + reconciliation step; no new language required for the effect.
effect_translations.falsification: Two approvals of differing payloads share one hash; a mutated payload executes under an old approval; or an action is marked complete without a reconciled receipt.
